nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: optional account and cloud service
nodes.rationale: Optional account: Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object for signaling. Holds the account's collections (never music), profiles and devices. Supports Google or email+password accounts.

nodes.label: GLUE folder: user's JSON file data store
nodes.rationale: The user's data: JSON files, no database (ADR 0009). Chosen on first run (usually Documents/GLUE), or kept in browser's own storage (OPFS) on a device with no folder. Contains profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, duplicates, files and backups.

nodes.label: Native analysis engine in Rust (glue-audio)
nodes.rationale: crates/glue-audio: same analysis in Rust, line-for-line port with JavaScript's numbers. GLUE Home 0.44 linked it, 0.45 made every stored file and decoded lossy files with check against stored results, 0.46 analyses with it. A deadline (glue_audio::control) stops a song past timeFor. Held to TypeScript's results by tests/golden.

nodes.label: Track: song representation in GLUE
nodes.rationale: Status is linked, missing or unlinked. rootId + relPath place it in a music folder; importPath is where a DJ library had it; fileKey for copies; sources are DJ libraries it came from. Has tags, info, rating, prep (Prepare tab: bpm, grid, cues), unwritten (info not written into file).

nodes.label: Profile: artist alias in GLUE
nodes.rationale: An artist alias: id, name, colour, BPM range. Signed in, account keeps list as union of every device's profiles. Deleted profile is final everywhere (gone). Each device keeps own choice (lastAlias). Code: src/lib/profiles.svelte.ts.

nodes.label: Collection: music library with folders and playlists
nodes.rationale: Music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, events. Sidebar views count songs with analysisState. Library's own views show one row per song, its best copy, and never a song whose file couldn't be analysed.

nodes.label: analysisState: tracking analysis completion
nodes.rationale: src/core/library/analysed.ts analysisState(t, a) returns: done, failed, waiting, elsewhere (another computer's song), or nofile. Sidebar, Stats, analysis bar and both queues use it.

nodes.label: Quality verdicts: lossless, hi-res, upsampled
nodes.rationale: src/core/audio/verdict.ts (Speklone's forensics). Hi-res judged by content past 24kHz above digital silence (ADR 0116). Steep top end with following content without frequent drop-outs is lossless (ADR 0119).

nodes.label: Duplicates: same recording and probable matches
nodes.rationale: Found by fingerprints ('same recording') and artist+title with lengths within 3s ('probable'). User can say 'Keep, not a duplicate' on a copy (meta.dupApart) or 'Mark as duplicates' on chosen songs (meta.dupManual). Only best copy shows and is used.

nodes.label: GLUE Home local link: HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:47400-47409
nodes.rationale: home/src-tauri/src/local.rs routes: /hello (who it is), /connect (token to live website), /fs/* (disk), /cache (analyses), /rpc (engine), /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders. Every route but /hello and /connect needs token (full or read-only).

nodes.label: Gluey: first tour, feature tours and help
nodes.rationale: ADR 0126: first tour once per person, tour per feature, help seen kept across account and GLUE folder. Tours as data in src/core/guide/tours.ts point at data-guide attributes. Help articles src/help/*.md; tips first time some views open.

hyperedges.label: GLUE Home operation: disk, engine and analysis
Collection management: tracks, profiles and storage
